005package org.wpilib.smartdashboard;
006
007import static org.wpilib.units.Units.Meters;
008
009import java.util.ArrayList;
010import java.util.List;
011import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Pose2d;
012import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Rotation2d;
013import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryLoggable;
014import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryTable;
015import org.wpilib.tunable.ComplexTunable;
016import org.wpilib.tunable.TunableRegistry;
017import org.wpilib.tunable.TunableTable;
018import org.wpilib.units.measure.Distance;
019
020/**
021 * 2D representation of game field for dashboards.
022 *
023 * <p>An object's pose is the location shown on the dashboard view. Note that for the robot, this
024 * may or may not match the internal odometry. For example, the robot is shown at a particular
025 * starting location, the pose in this class would represent the actual location on the field, but
026 * the robot's internal state might have a 0,0,0 pose (unless it's initialized to something
027 * different).
028 *
029 * <p>As the user is able to edit the pose, code performing updates should get the robot pose,
030 * transform it as appropriate (e.g. based on wheel odometry), and set the new pose.
031 *
032 * <p>This class provides methods to set the robot pose, but other objects can also be shown by
033 * using the getObject() function. Other objects can also have multiple poses (which will show the
034 * object at multiple locations).
035 *
036 * <p>Field poses use the center of the field as the origin, with +X toward the blue alliance wall
037 * and +Y to the left when facing +X. Zero rotation faces +X, and positive rotation is
038 * counterclockwise.
039 */
040public class Field2d implements TelemetryLoggable, ComplexTunable, AutoCloseable {
041  /** Constructor. */
042  public Field2d() {
043    m_objects.add(new FieldObject2d("Robot", Pose2d.ZERO));
044  }
045
046  @Override
047  public synchronized void close() {
048    TunableRegistry.remove(this);
049  }
050
051  /**
052   * Set the robot pose from a Pose object.
053   *
054   * @param pose 2D pose
055   */
056  public synchronized void setRobotPose(Pose2d pose) {
057    m_objects.get(0).setPose(pose);
058  }
059
060  /**
061   * Set the robot pose from x, y, and rotation.
062   *
063   * @param x X location, in meters
064   * @param y Y location, in meters
065   * @param rotation rotation
066   */
067  public synchronized void setRobotPose(double x, double y, Rotation2d rotation) {
068    m_objects.get(0).setPose(x, y, rotation);
069  }
070
071  /**
072   * Set the robot pose from x, y, and rotation.
073   *
074   * @param x X location
075   * @param y Y location
076   * @param rotation rotation
077   */
078  public synchronized void setRobotPose(Distance x, Distance y, Rotation2d rotation) {
079    m_objects.get(0).setPose(x.in(Meters), y.in(Meters), rotation);
080  }
081
082  /**
083   * Get the robot pose.
084   *
085   * @return 2D pose
086   */
087  public synchronized Pose2d getRobotPose() {
088    return m_objects.get(0).getPose();
089  }
090
091  /**
092   * Get or create a field object.
093   *
094   * @param name The field object's name.
095   * @return Field object
096   */
097  public synchronized FieldObject2d getObject(String name) {
098    for (FieldObject2d obj : m_objects) {
099      if (obj.m_name.equals(name)) {
100        return obj;
101      }
102    }
103    FieldObject2d obj = new FieldObject2d(name);
104    m_objects.add(obj);
105    publishChildTunable(obj.m_name, obj.m_posesTunable);
106    return obj;
107  }
108
109  /**
110   * Get the robot object.
111   *
112   * @return Field object for robot
113   */
114  public synchronized FieldObject2d getRobotObject() {
115    return m_objects.get(0);
116  }
117
118  @Override
119  public void logTo(TelemetryTable table) {
120    synchronized (this) {
121      for (FieldObject2d obj : m_objects) {
122        synchronized (obj) {
123          table.log(obj.m_name, obj.m_poses.toArray(new Pose2d[0]));
124        }
125      }
126    }
127  }
128
129  @Override
130  public String getTelemetryType() {
131    return "Field2d";
132  }
133
134  /**
135   * Gets the tunable type.
136   *
137   * @return Field2d type.
138   */
139  @Override
140  public String getTunableType() {
141    return "Field2d";
142  }
143
144  /**
145   * Publishes field objects to a tunable table.
146   *
147   * @param table Tunable table.
148   */
149  @Override
150  public synchronized void publishTunable(TunableTable table) {
151    for (FieldObject2d obj : m_objects) {
152      table.publish(obj.m_name, obj.m_posesTunable);
153    }
154  }
155
156  private final List<FieldObject2d> m_objects = new ArrayList<>();
157}
